_meta.title: Blaque Baux — Block Derivatives Catalog
_meta.source: Derivatives Master Reference (Kareem Williams / Carter Warrens, Blaque Baux initiative)
_meta.status: reference taxonomy — no pricing code yet; the backbone Block hangs off
_meta.note: Each entry is a BUILDING BLOCK, not a standalone strategy. Value is in composition (hedging / arbitrage / combination) and in the engine's governance — none is alpha alone.

asset_classes.equity: Equity derivatives (forwards, structured notes, options, variance/vol)

strategies.name: Forward Rate Agreement
legs: pays PV of (R_actual - R_fixed) if rates rose
strategies.settlement: cash, PV-discounted, at settlement (usually effective date)
strategies.payoff: settlement = notional * (R_actual - R_fixed) * daycount, discounted to PV
combinations: hedge a single future funding period
strategies.use: lock a single future borrowing/lending rate

strategies.name: Interest Rate Swap
strategies.settlement: net cash each payment date; principal never exchanged

strategies.name: Average Rate Swap
legs: pays average floating rate over period
strategies.payoff: float leg = period-average of the reference
strategies.use: hedge average exposure over a period

strategies.name: Callable Swap
strategies.use: swap with the right to exit early

strategies.name: Swap in Arrears
strategies.payoff: floating fixed at END of period (arrears) not start
strategies.use: express a view on the forward-rate convexity

strategies.name: OIS Swap
combinations: discounting curve / basis vs term rates
strategies.use: hedge against the O/N funding curve

strategies.name: Treasury Lock
legs: pays based on future Treasury price/yield
strategies.payoff: locks a future govt-bond yield for issuance
strategies.use: lock a future govt funding level

strategies.name: Zero Coupon Swap
legs: pays fixed lump sum at maturity
strategies.settlement: one fixed bullet vs periodic floating
strategies.payoff: fixed side is a single maturity payment
strategies.use: swap a bullet fixed vs periodic floating

strategies.name: Onshore IRS
strategies.payoff: vanilla IRS in a restricted market

strategies.name: Cap / Floor
legs: pays if reference > cap strike (or < floor strike)
strategies.payoff: strip of caplets/floorlets on the reference rate

strategies.name: Collar
strategies.settlement: cash on breach of either bound
strategies.payoff: long cap financed by short floor
combinations: cheapen a cap by giving up downside
strategies.combination_research: collar_overlay.jl — guardrail: SPY Sharpe 1.01->1.39, tail -18% vs -24%, at the cost of upside

strategies.name: Cap/Floor Straddle
legs: long cap + long floor, same strike & dates
strategies.settlement: cash on any large rate move

strategies.name: Cap/Floor Spread
legs: long cap at strike1 + short cap at strike2

strategies.name: Swaption
legs: grants right to enter an IRS

strategies.name: European Swaption
legs: right to enter IRS on ONE fixed date
strategies.use: one-date option to enter a swap

strategies.name: Bermudan Swaption
legs: right to enter IRS on MULTIPLE fixed dates

strategies.name: Straddle Swaption
legs: right to enter IRS as fixed payer OR receiver

strategies.name: Mark-to-Market Cross-Currency Swap
strategies.settlement: net cash + periodic notional MTM reset
strategies.payoff: xccy swap with FX notional resets

strategies.name: Non-Deliverable Cross-Currency Swap
legs: NDF fixing vs strike, settled in USD
strategies.payoff: xccy swap on a non-deliverable currency

strategies.name: Interest Rate Basis Swap
legs: pays floating index A plus spread

strategies.name: Constant Maturity Swap
strategies.use: express or hedge the shape of the swap curve

strategies.name: CMS Spread Option
legs: pays when CMS spread exceeds strike
strategies.use: take convex exposure to yield-curve shape

strategies.name: Range Accrual
legs: pays coupon for in-range observation days
strategies.use: earn conditional carry while rates remain in a range

strategies.name: Zero-Coupon Inflation Swap
strategies.settlement: single net cash payment at maturity
strategies.use: exchange cumulative inflation for a fixed rate

strategies.name: Inflation Cap / Floor
legs: pays when inflation is above cap or below floor
strategies.use: protect against unexpectedly high or low inflation

strategies.name: Average Rate Forward
legs: pays average rate vs agreed forward rate

strategies.name: Target Forward
legs: FX at better rate if spot stays in range
FX at worse rate if spot breaks barrier

combinations: cheapen a forward, take barrier risk

strategies.name: Forward Accumulator
legs: buys FX daily when spot is below barrier

combinations: accumulate a position cheaply, barrier risk

strategies.name: FX Swap
legs: Currency A spot then forward date
Currency B spot then forward date

strategies.name: FX Swap Onshore
legs: local currency near leg / far leg

strategies.name: Risk Reversal
legs: long call + short put (or vice versa)

strategies.name: Straddle
legs: long call + long put, same strike & expiry

strategies.name: Strangle
legs: long OTM call + long OTM put

strategies.name: One-Touch / No-Touch
legs: pays fixed amount if spot touches / does NOT touch barrier
strategies.settlement: fixed cash if barrier condition met

strategies.name: Simple Barrier Option

combinations: cheapen a vanilla with a barrier

strategies.name: Double Barrier Option
legs: pays out if EITHER barrier is triggered

strategies.name: Average Rate Option (Asian)
legs: pays based on average rate vs strike

strategies.name: Digital Option

strategies.name: Quanto Option

strategies.name: Non-Deliverable Forward Onshore

strategies.name: NDF FX Swap
strategies.payoff: cash-settled FX swap on restricted FX

strategies.name: Autocallable Equity Note

strategies.payoff: conditional coupons w/ early redemption + downside barrier
combinations: yield enhancement vs owning the stock

strategies.name: Equity Forward
legs: delivers underlying shares or cash equivalent

strategies.name: Amortizing Strike Forward
strategies.payoff: forward with a declining strike schedule

strategies.name: Asian Option (Equity)

strategies.name: Accelerated Share Repurchase

strategies.name: Forward Start Option

strategies.name: Cliquet Option

strategies.name: Variance Contingent Swap

strategies.name: Bespoke Option

strategies.name: Covered Call

strategies.name: Condor Spread
